questions.question: The autobiography of which of the following actors is titled 'The Substance And The Shadow: An Autobiography'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dilip Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Dilip Kumar**, a legendary actor in Indian cinema, is known for his significant contributions to the film industry.
 
• His autobiography, titled **'The Substance And The Shadow: An Autobiography'**, offers a detailed account of his life and illustrious career.
 
• The book was published in **2014** and has been highly acclaimed for its in-depth portrayal of his journey.
 
• Dilip Kumar, often referred to as the **'Tragedy King'**, has won numerous awards and accolades for his performances over several decades.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dilip Kumar's Real Name:** His birth name is Muhammad Yusuf Khan, and he adopted the screen name Dilip Kumar for his acting career.
 
• **Career Highlights:** He debuted in the film **'Jwar Bhata'** in 1944 and went on to star in classics like 'Mughal-e-Azam', 'Naya Daur', and 'Devdas'.
 
• **Honors and Awards:** Dilip Kumar received numerous awards, including **eight Filmfare Awards for Best Actor** and the **Padma Bhushan** and **Padma Vibhushan** from the Government of India.
 
• **Influence and Legacy:** He is considered one of the greatest actors in Indian cinema, influencing several generations of actors with his method acting style.
 
• **Personal Life:** Dilip Kumar was married to actress **Saira Banu**, and their marriage was widely celebrated in the Indian film industry.

questions.question: ‘The Race of My Life : An Autobiography’ is the autobiography of which of the following persons?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Milkha Singh.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Milkha Singh: **

__
 
• **Milkha Singh was born in 1929** in** Gobindpura village **in the Muzaffargarh district of Pakistan.
 
• During the 1947 partition, he became an orphan and moved to India.
 
• **Known as the Flying Sikh, Padma Shree Milkha Singh was an Indian field sprinter and track runner.**
 
• He is the only a**thlete to win a gold medal **in the 400 meters race at the Commonwealth Games and the Asian Games.
 
• Milkha Singh set a **national record in the 1960 Olympics** by winning fourth place in the 400m race in 45.73 seconds.
 
• This record remained for almost 40 years.
 
• He was conferred India’s **fourth-highest civilian honour, Padma Shri **for his sporting achievements.
 
• **‘Bhaag Milkha Bhaag’**, directed by Rakeysh Omprakash Mehra and starring Farhan Akhtar and Sonam Kapoor, portrayed Milkha Singh’s biography.
 
• His autobiography, **The Race of My Life** (co-written with his daughter Sonia Sanwalka), was published in 2013. 
 
• Apart from these achievements, in 1960, he was persuaded by then Prime Minister Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru to run against Abdul Khaliq in Pakistan, whom he defeated. He then received the title of “the Flying Sikh” from General Ayub.
 
• The veteran athlete succumbed to death on 18th June 2021 from COVID-related complications at 91.

questions.question: 'Ace Against Odds' is the autobiography of a sports personality playing the game of __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Ace Against Odds** is the autobiography of **Sania Mirza**, an Indian professional tennis player.
 
• The book was released in **July 2016**.
 
• Sania Mirza is the most successful female Indian tennis player, with numerous **Grand Slam titles** to her name.
 
• The autobiography details her journey from a young girl in Hyderabad to becoming the **world number one in women's doubles**.
 
• The book provides insights into her professional and personal life, including the challenges she faced and overcame in her career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sania Mirza's Achievements**

 
 
• She has won six Grand Slam titles: three in mixed doubles and three in women's doubles.
 
• She was ranked as India's No. 1 player by the Women's Tennis Association from 2003 to her retirement from singles in 2013.
 
• In 2015, she became the first Indian to be ranked world No. 1 in the WTA doubles rankings.
 
 
 
• **Grand Slam Titles**
 
 
• Sania Mirza won the 2009 Australian Open mixed doubles title with Mahesh Bhupathi.
 
• She claimed the 2012 French Open mixed doubles title, again partnering with Mahesh Bhupathi.
 
• Her first women's doubles Grand Slam title came at the 2015 Wimbledon Championships with Martina Hingis.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Facts**
 
 
• She received the Arjuna Award in 2004, India's second-highest sporting honor.
 
• Sania was awarded the Padma Shri in 2006, the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
• She was honored with the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 2015, the highest sporting honor in India.
 
• In 2016, she was conferred with the Padma Bhushan, India's third-highest civilian award.
